rationale: Evidence-gated verification cascade: preserve v002's adaptive dual frontiers, but buy broader exploration by replacing routine Exa checks with cheap first-pass checks and selective escalation. Unlike discarded v001, this does not commit to a census anchor.
instructions: Define X and Y exactly, with entity unit, exclusions, dates, eligible subtypes and group-membership rules. Start sequentially with one X-only search, one Y-only search, and one conjunction search. Maintain two deduplicated frontiers and a ledger containing canonical identity, aliases, source-backed X/Y status, unresolved facts and next action. After this baseline, run short discovery/check rounds. First check source-backed candidates on Parallel, supplying existing evidence and requesting identity-matched proof for both predicates, focusing retrieval on the missing fact. Do not recheck already established facts. Treat no result as unresolved, not false; reject only on explicit contradiction or a demonstrably exhaustive applicable source. Escalate promising unresolved cases to Exa when identity ambiguity, conflicting sources or inaccessible evidence makes the cheap check insufficient. Rank work by expected verified additions per total remaining resolution cost, but include one neglected subtype or reverse-frontier probe per discovery round to avoid starving unfamiliar candidates. After two discovery searches yield no new plausible identities, prohibit further synonymous conjunction queries until a genuinely different source, partition or frontier has been tried. Track marginal yield and spend by action, including every candidate in a batch. Reserve at least 35% of initial budget for evidence work; halt discovery whenever the estimated pending-check cost needs the remaining funds. Finish with an identity, scope and date audit and submit only supported intersections, without claiming completeness from saturation.
routing_rules: Use Parallel alone for baseline discovery and first-pass check_candidates, default tier, 8 discovery results and 4 exact-check results. Escalate check_candidates selectively to Exa alone, normally 4 results; never rerun an entire batch because one identity is unresolved. Cost a batch as the sum of candidate queries and provider charges; lower result counts are not assumed cheaper. Permit at most one initial Exa discovery probe after Parallel stagnation, retained only for useful new candidates or evidence. Provider yield supports this as a cost hypothesis, not a guarantee of equal accuracy. No broad auto-routing or routine also variants. Apply authoritative-domain filters only to targeted evidence retrieval and relax them when needed. Publication-date filters only when publication dates define eligibility; verify effective dates from content.
fetch_policy: Reuse cached source facts. Fetch authoritative pages when they can settle a missing predicate or identity more cheaply than another search, and multi-candidate lists when they add plausible identities. Do not fetch every result or duplicate evidence already sufficient for a decision. If a page is blocked or uninformative, make one targeted alternate-source attempt rather than a fetch chain.
title: Evidence-gated verification cascade
